description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F780025
Sheriff’s File # 26001220
PLAINTIFF – Madison Commons of Red Bank Condominium Association, INC., vs:
DEFENDANTS- Right Time Leasing LLC,
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 3rd day of August, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Red Bank, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 15 C1537, Block 115 Tax Map of Borough of Red Bank
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
142 South Street Unit 9D Red Bank, NJ 07701
Number of Feet to Nearest Cross Street (approx.): 400 feet to Bergen Place
Dimensions (approx.): 597 Square Feet (Tax Map)
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain DEED recorded in the Office of the Register/Clerk of Monmouth County in OR Book 9116 at Page 395, et seq., New Jersey, and/or the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Monmouth County.
The property is sold subject to restrictions and easements of record, including but not limited to, The Madison Commons of Red Bank Condominium and or The Madison Commons of Red Bank Condominium Association, INC. Master Deed and by-laws originally recorded in the Office of the Monmouth clerk/register on March 18, 1986, in Book 4640, Page 504 et seq, as amended thereafter.
Plaintiff's good faith estimate upset price $22,449.18 (exclusive of any interest and Sheriff fee(s)).
The property's occupancy is unknown. The property is sold subject to any unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water and sewer charges/liens and other municipal assessments including but not limited to tax sale certificate no. 23-00012 sold to Stonefield Invest Fund IV, LLC, on October 23, 2023, recorded on November 30, 2023 in the Monmouth County clerk's office in Mortgage Book or 9669, page 4182 with an estimated amount of $29,187.48, and tax sale certificate no. 21-00011, sold to Fig Cust FIGNJ19LLC & Sec pty, on September 27, 2021, recorded on November 10, 2021 in the Monmouth County Clerk's office in Mortgage Book or-9557, page 5295. The amount(s) due can be obtained from the local taxing authority . Subject to all prior matters, liens, and any any litigation. Subject to lawful advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. Subject to any prior mortgages, liens and judgements.
All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon. The outstanding taxes, lien(s) and or encumbrances disclosed in this publication are amount estimates only. It is the responsibility of any potential bidder at sale to determine the amount due, which can be obtained from the local taxing authority. Plaintiff has no obligation to further investigate, publish or announce any subsequently accruing taxes, liens, and/or encumbrances and any purchaser absolutely and unequivocally release and right to challenge the validity of the sale based on the existence of same. If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Plaintiff or the Plaintiff’s attorney, including but not limited to any damages, cost(s) and expense(s).
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $24,225.65.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: June 10, 2026
The Catelli Law Firm, L.L.C.
365 Broad Street
Suite 4R
Red Bank, NJ 07701
